description: A hit remade with the person's own AI video model, the original clip as its reference. `video_id` or `url` (or `format_id`: its reference hit); `mode`: swap_person, swap_place, swap_product, restyle_3d, character, episode. One plan per model, each prompt written for the original clip and cut at the hit's cuts; one model's first request (`model`), all with detail='full'. Nothing generates here.

detail.description: summary (the default): the compact answer, a model's prompts marked for_model=true. full: every field, with the original bilingual and model text.

format_id.description: A format: alone, its reference hit; with a hit, that hit in that format.

lang.description: The creator's language. 'en' answers in the English Shorti wrote: never translate its Korean yourself.

model.description: Whose first request the default answer carries: seedance-2.5, minimax-h3, kling-3.0-motion-control, wan-3.0 (else the first).

url.description: The hit, by the post's link.
